behavior: A trigger that has focus guards beside its element has one root node. `NavigationMenu.Viewport` in a positioner has one root node too. Each popup part with a focus manager has one root node too. Script keeps its two inside focus guards beside its element. `Combobox.Popup` and `Combobox.Input` also keep their dismiss button beside their element, and `Select.Positioner` holds the style element of `Select.Popup`. A rule of `<style scoped>`, `v-show`, a custom directive and `<Transition>` of the consumer thus apply to the element of the part, also while the nodes are in the document.
